description: This file contains utility classes and functions for generating and handling anchor boxes in object detection models, specifically for the RetinaNet architecture. It defines parameters for anchors, functions to generate anchors, compute bounding box transformations, and manage layer shapes within a neural network model.

classes.name: AnchorParameters
classes.description: Class representing parameters for anchor box generation, including sizes, strides, ratios, and scales.

methods.name: anchor_targets_bbox
methods.description: Generates anchor targets for bounding box detection, computing labels and regression targets for training.

methods.name: layer_shapes
methods.description: Computes the output shapes of each layer in a model given an input image shape.

methods.name: make_shapes_callback
methods.description: Creates a callback function to retrieve the shapes of feature pyramid levels based on the model.

methods.name: guess_shapes
methods.description: Guesses the shapes of feature pyramid levels based on the input image shape and pyramid levels.

methods.name: anchors_for_shape
methods.description: Generates anchor boxes for a given image shape, pyramid levels, and anchor parameters.

methods.name: shift
methods.description: Produces shifted anchors over a feature map grid based on shape, stride, and base anchors.

methods.name: generate_anchors
methods.description: Creates anchor boxes with specified base size, aspect ratios, and scales.

methods.name: bbox_transform
methods.description: Calculates bounding box regression targets for anchors given ground truth boxes.
